channel.description: Recent content in tour-dates on Loud Legends

item.title: Deftones Announce 2026 European and UK Tour With Denzel Curry and Drug Church
item.description: Deftones are heading back to Europe in 2026. The Sacramento-based alternative metal band has confirmed a 15-date arena tour across Europe and the United Kingdom in support of their upcoming album Private Music.

item.title: Watch AC/DC Live in Düsseldorf Featuring Angus Young, Brian Johnson, and New Touring Members
item.description: Hard rock icons AC/DC played to a packed stadium in Düsseldorf, Germany, on July 8. The concert took place at Merkur Spiel-Arena as part of the band’s summer 2025 leg of the “Power Up” European tour.

item.title: DEFTONES Tease Possible NEW SONG Or ALBUM Release With Cryptic Message During London Show
item.description: Deftones may be getting ready to release new music. During their concert at Crystal Palace Park in London on June 29, the band displayed a graphic on large screens near the stage.

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT's WES BORLAND Cosplays As Skull-Faced JAMES HETFIELD At Metallica’s Denver Show
item.description: Limp Bizkit guitarist Wes Borland turned heads at Metallica’s Denver show on Friday by dressing up like a skull-faced version of 1980s James Hetfield (watch below). The look included a “Metal Up Your Ass” t-shirt and white high-top sneakers, all while performing a full 10-song set.

item.title: AC/DC Adds More Australian Shows As Fans Struggle With Ticket Website Issues
item.description: AC/DC has added three new dates to its upcoming Power Up tour in Australia. The new shows are scheduled for: November 16 in Melbourne at Melbourne Cricket Ground November 25 in Sydney at Accor Stadium December 18 in Brisbane at Suncorp Stadium Fans can find tickets and all official dates at acdc.

item.title: HOLLYWOOD UNDEAD Releases Emotional New Single 'SAVIOR': 'We Can’t Wait For You To Hear It'
item.description: Rock group Hollywood Undead has dropped a new single titled “Savior” (watch it below), offering fans a more personal and emotional look at the band’s sound. The track is out now through Sumerian Records.

item.title: AC/DC Announces 2025 Stadium Tour of Australia With Amyl and The Sniffers
item.description: AC/DC is heading back to their roots. The legendary Australian rock band has announced a five-city stadium tour across the country for November and December 2025. This will be their first Australian tour in ten years.

item.title: REVOCATION Announces New Album 'New Gods, New Masters' With Guest Appearances From Cattle Decapitation, Gorguts, And More
item.description: Revocation will release their ninth studio album, New Gods, New Masters, on September 26 via Metal Blade Records. It’s their fifth record under the label and the follow-up to 2022’s Netherheaven.

item.title: LARS ULRICH Says Younger Fans Ignore METALLICA Classics: 'They're More Into the New Stuff'
item.description: Not every Metallica fan has Master of Puppets tattooed on their brain. According to Lars Ulrich, a surprising number of listeners are skipping the band’s old-school thrash masterpieces in favor of more recent material.

item.title: JESSE LEACH Talks About KILLSWITCH ENGAGE's 'Aftermath': 'We All Have a Responsibility'
item.description: Killswitch Engage isn’t wasting time with metaphors or feel-good slogans in their latest single. The video for “Aftermath” just dropped, and it doesn’t sugarcoat a thing. If you were expecting a fun, breakdown-heavy anthem about “staying strong,” keep scrolling.

item.title: BRIAN WELCH on KORN's New Album: 'We're Doing It All On Tape'
item.description: Korn is back in the studio, but don’t expect any instant gratification. This time, they’re ditching modern convenience for a much older, sweatier process. During a chat with BBC Radio 1’s Rock Show With Daniel P Carter (as transcribed by The PRP, guitarist Brian “Head” Welch explained that the band has fully embraced analog recording.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE starts recording vocals as MEGADETH’s 17th studio album nears completion
item.description: The next Megadeth record has been crawling toward completion for months. Since the release of The Sick, The Dying… and the Dead! back in 2022, work on its successor has quietly advanced.

item.title: Kirk Hammett Rules Out Retirement From Metallica Despite 62 Years of Age
item.description: Kirk Hammett has no interest in slowing down. Speaking to Metal Hammer, he dismissed the idea of retirement entirely. “I don’t believe in retirement. Retirement is something that’s been forced onto people; I don’t believe musicians are allowed to retire,” he said.

item.title: Steel Panther Expands 2025 "Feel The Steel" Tour With New U.S. And Europe Dates
item.description: Fifteen years after dropping their debut Feel The Steel, Steel Panther is still out there doing what they do best: mocking, exaggerating, and somehow keeping hair metal alive with a straight face and a wink.

item.title: Disturbed & Megadeth Join Forces for The Sickness 25th-Anniversary Tour
item.description: Okay—stop what you’re doing—pause Love Island, put down the ghost pepper challenge, mute your ex’s chaotic MySpace playlist from 2008 (yes, it still plays in your head)—because we need to talk about DISTURBED and MEGADETH teaming up for a European tour in 2025… and frankly, the timeline has collapsed in on itself.

item.title: Linkin Park Announces 2025 Global Tour Across 50+ Cities
item.description: It looks like Linkin Park has made good on their not-so-subtle hints and officially announced a globe-trotting tour to support their upcoming album, From Zero, set to drop this Friday.

item.title: Slipknot’s 2025 European Tour Announced; See Details
item.description: The masters of mayhem in terrifying masks are set to invade Europe again. Slipknot—yes, the band that makes mosh pits feel like a full-contact sport—dropped the news on Instagram about their upcoming 2025 tour.

item.title: Metallica Returns to Australia and New Zealand This November
item.description: Metallica’s unyielding journey continues, with the band slated to storm Australia and New Zealand next November. This leg of their endless ‘M72 World Tour’ has a lineup that’s sure to turn some heads, featuring Evanescence and Suicidal Tendencies as supporting acts.

item.title: Watch: Korn Celebrates 30 Years with Epic Anniversary Concert in Los Angeles
item.description: Nu metal’s elder statesmen, Korn, threw a massive party this past weekend in Los Angeles. Their 30th Anniversary bash at BMO Stadium was less of a concert and more of a nu metal reunion, complete with thousands of fans who still remember when baggy jeans and wallet chains were a statement.

item.title: KORN’s Brian 'Head' Welch on Mortality: "I Want to Die in a Bed, Not On Stage"
item.description: Brian “Head” Welch from KORN isn’t buying into the whole “die on stage” fantasy. Asked recently about his 2014 comment—where he hinted at retiring by 60—he didn’t exactly backpedal.

item.title: Metallica Confirms 2025 Headline Tour with Iconic Support Acts
item.description: Metallica is rolling out a 2025 North American tour, bringing their mix of old-school riffs and new album jams to a lineup that includes Sick New World and Sonic Temple festivals.

item.title: Korn Invites Fans to Create Art for 30th Anniversary—See How You Can Get Involved
item.description: Seems like Korn is dusting off the nostalgia box and pulling out another fan art contest—this time to mark 30 years of Korn wreaking havoc on the rock scene.

item.title: Slipknot’s 25th Anniversary Kicks Off with Nothing After 1999; VIDEO
item.description: Slipknot has been teasing this nostalgia-heavy tour for what feels like forever, and last night in Noblesville, Indiana, they finally unleashed the beast. Their ‘Here Comes the Pain Tour’ is officially underway, celebrating 25 years of their self-titled debut—a record that pretty much defined what it meant to be an angry, sweaty teenager in the late ’90s.
